title: Ukitaka kuhisi Japani ukiwa Nagoya, nenda Osu
label: Osu

text.Say you come to Nagoya and want to see s: Tuseme umefika Nagoya na unataka kuona kitu cha Kijapani kabisa.
text.There is a place I recommend at times li: Kuna sehemu ninayopendekeza kwa wakati kama huo.
text.Even for me as a Japanese person, Osu is: Hata mimi nikiwa Mjapani, naona Osu ni sehemu ya Kijapani sana.
text.The buildings and the colors used are ve: Majengo na rangi zilizotumiwa ni za Kijapani sana.
text.🏮 The Osu shopping arcade: 🏮 Njia ya maduka yenye paa ya Osu
text.Osu Shopping Street is a shopping street: Osu Shopping Street ni barabara ya maduka katika eneo linaloitwa Osu.
text.At the end of Osu Shopping Street, there: Mwisho wa Osu Shopping Street kuna hekalu linaloitwa Osu Kannon.
text.Including Osu Kannon, I think all of it: Pamoja na Osu Kannon, nadhani eneo lote lina hali ya Kijapani sana.
text.It is a place where even I, a Japanese p: Ni sehemu ambayo hata mimi nikiwa Mjapani hufikiri, “Lo, hapa ni Kijapani kabisa.”
text.If you want to feel Japan in Nagoya, I a: Ukitaka kuhisi Japani ukiwa Nagoya, ninapendekeza pia uende Osu.
text.For sightseeing in Nagoya, go to the wee: Ukitalii Nagoya, nenda kwenye hafla za wikendi za Hisaya-odori
